The digest's net_debt_to_ebitda of -3.37x (net cash) is from the 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 and PRE-DATES the Chart Industries close on 2026-07-16 -- post-close leverage is materially higher than this trailing figure, though $3.1B TTM free cash flow supports rapid deleveraging.
